FYTotal revenue for 4Q25 amounted to 1,416 million baht, 
increasing by 144 million baht or + 11% YoY, primarily due to road 
construction projects, which are mostly small -scale projects with 
shorter project cycles and faster revenue recognition, contributing 
an increase of more than THB 100 million, or + 16% YoY. Alongside 
this, revenue from construction material sales continued to 
expand, rising by more than THB 37 million, or + 40% YoY.
Total revenue for FY25 amounted to 4,899 million baht, 
decreasing by 69 million baht or -1% YoY, mainly due to an 
earthquake that occurred in late March, together with delays in signing new 
contracts, which postponed the delivery and revenue recognition of several 
projects beyond the original timeline. Despite these challenges, the Company 
successfully completed and delivered more than 20 projects during the year. 
In addition, increased revenue from construction material sales helped 
mitigate the impact from the deferral of construction project revenue. This 
reflects the Company’s strategy of diversifying risk through a balanced mix of 
construction projects of various sizes, as well as expanding into new 
businesses, to enhance flexibility and continuity in revenue recognition.“Strong Fourth -Quarter 
Performance Offsets Annual 
Headwinds ”

FYThe company had a gross profit margin of 12.9% in 4Q25, 
increasing by 5.3% YoY. The main reasons were improved cost 
control efficiency, resulting in cost savings from small -scale road 
projects, dam and reservoir projects, including the receipt of the 
Escalator factor (K) compensation to partially offset the increased 
costs. 
The company had a gross profit margin of 7.3% in FY25, 
decreasing by -1.6% YoY . The main reason was the increase in 
budgets for railway projects. Based on the current assessment, 
extensions of construction periods and certain operational 
processes beyond the Company’s control have been key factors 
contributing to higher indirect costs. These matters are being 
continuously monitored and reviewed to enable the 
implementation of appropriate measures to control and mitigate 
the impacts. However, the Company implemented cost 
management measures and closely adjusted its operational plans 
to limit the impact and maintain overall profitability efficiency.“Strong Q4 Margin Recovery

The administrative expenses for 4Q25 amounted to 103 million 
baht, increasing by 35 million baht or + 51% YoY. These expenses 
were incurred to enhance the overall management efficiency 
across the Group, including certain expenses of the Segment 
manufacturing plant. In addition, the Company recognized a one -
time expected credit loss allowance on financial assets in 
accordance with financial reporting standards amounting to THB 11 
million.  It is noted that during the same period last year, there was 
a reversal of litigation provisions amounting to THB 22 million 
following the conclusion of legal cases, which helped offset 
administrative expenses in that period.
The administrative expenses for FY25 amounted to 38 1 million

were incurred to strengthen the Group’s management efficiency, 
including costs related to the Segment manufacturing plant during 
the production preparation phase prior to the gradual 
commencement of operations in the fourth quarter. Additionally, 
the Company recognized a one -time expected credit loss 
allowance on financial assets in accordance with financial 
reporting standards amounting to THB 13 million.“Strengthening Organizational Efficiency and

factors leading to higher indirect costs. Nevertheless, the Company
